# Glyphfield

Forms, drawn in light. A fixed grid of custom glyphs uses projected face shading to reveal dimensional objects in native Canvas2D.

- [Source and installation](https://github.com/achourahmed/glyphfield)
- [Skill instructions](downloads/SKILL.md)
- [Skill ZIP](downloads/acubic-glyph-hero.zip)
- [Standalone starter](downloads/hero-starter.zip)

The acubic-glyph-hero skill uses the portable Agent Skills format. Compatible agents can load the skill folder; other coding agents can read SKILL.md and its linked resources. Optional OpenAI UI metadata is not required. The JavaScript starter works without an AI agent or a build step.

The ACubic logo is the starter's example. The showcase also includes a cube, torus, sphere, and a drawing tool for extruded custom outlines.

Install from your project with `npx skills add achourahmed/glyphfield` (Node.js 22.20+), then choose your coding agent. Add `-g` for installation across projects.
